title: List all cities that have at least one active magnet school serving a K-8 g
question: List all cities that have at least one active magnet school serving a K-8 grade span and reporting FRPM data. For each city, show: (1) the total number of such schools, (2) the average percentage of K-12 students eligible for free or reduced-price meals, and (3) the average combined SAT score (Math + Reading + Writing) for those schools that have valid SAT data. Only include cities where the average FRPM eligibility rate is greater than 20%.

prediction.sql:
WITH eligible_schools AS (
    SELECT
        s."XCL_041" AS cds,
        s."XCL_050" AS city,
        f."XCL_020" + f."XCL_022" AS frpm_count,
        f."XCL_019" AS enrollment_k12
    FROM schools AS s
    INNER JOIN frpm AS f ON s."XCL_041" = f."XCL_001"
    WHERE s."XCL_044" = 'Active'
      AND s."XCL_077" = 1
      AND s."XCL_074" = 'K-8'
),
city_stats AS (
    SELECT
        es.city,
        COUNT(es.cds) AS total_schools,
        AVG(CASE WHEN es.enrollment_k12 > 0 THEN es.frpm_count * 100.0 / es.enrollment_k12 ELSE NULL END) AS avg_fprm_rate
    FROM eligible_schools AS es
    GROUP BY es.city
    HAVING AVG(CASE WHEN es.enrollment_k12 > 0 THEN es.frpm_count * 100.0 / es.enrollment_k12 ELSE NULL END) > 20
),
city_sat AS (
    SELECT
        es.city,
        AVG(sat."XCL_037" + sat."XCL_038" + sat."XCL_039") AS avg_combined_sat
    FROM eligible_schools AS es
    INNER JOIN satscores AS sat ON es.cds = sat."XCL_030"
    WHERE sat."XCL_037" IS NOT NULL
      AND sat."XCL_038" IS NOT NULL
      AND sat."XCL_039" IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY es.city
)
SELECT
    cs.city,
    cs.total_schools,
    cs.avg_fprm_rate,
    csat.avg_combined_sat
FROM city_stats AS cs
LEFT JOIN city_sat AS csat ON cs.city = csat.city

compiled_semantic_plan.candidate_sql:
WITH eligible_schools AS (
    SELECT
        s."XCL_041" AS cds,
        s."XCL_050" AS city,
        f."XCL_020" + f."XCL_022" AS frpm_count,
        f."XCL_019" AS enrollment_k12
    FROM schools AS s
    INNER JOIN frpm AS f ON s."XCL_041" = f."XCL_001"
    WHERE s."XCL_044" = 'Active'
      AND s."XCL_077" = 1
      AND s."XCL_074" = 'K-8'
),
city_stats AS (
    SELECT
        es.city,
        COUNT(es.cds) AS total_schools,
        AVG(CASE WHEN es.enrollment_k12 > 0 THEN es.frpm_count * 100.0 / es.enrollment_k12 ELSE NULL END) AS avg_fprm_rate
    FROM eligible_schools AS es
    GROUP BY es.city
    HAVING AVG(CASE WHEN es.enrollment_k12 > 0 THEN es.frpm_count * 100.0 / es.enrollment_k12 ELSE NULL END) > 20
),
city_sat AS (
    SELECT
        es.city,
        AVG(sat."XCL_037" + sat."XCL_038" + sat."XCL_039") AS avg_combined_sat
    FROM eligible_schools AS es
    INNER JOIN satscores AS sat ON es.cds = sat."XCL_030"
    WHERE sat."XCL_037" IS NOT NULL
      AND sat."XCL_038" IS NOT NULL
      AND sat."XCL_039" IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY es.city
)
SELECT
    cs.city,
    cs.total_schools,
    cs.avg_fprm_rate,
    csat.avg_combined_sat
FROM city_stats AS cs
LEFT JOIN city_sat AS csat ON cs.city = csat.city
